requiredLifecycleEvidence: activity status and durable reason sources
effectiveInstance.configuration: null or a schema/hash-bound strict JSON object validated by the item-specific equipment definition

inventorySerialization.identityContinuity: the equipped instance identity remains the same whole-item identity when returned to inventory and equipped again
inventorySerialization.revision: increments on every inventory/equipment custody transition or item-specific state change
inventorySerialization.activity: durable activity status and exact reasons survive inventory, transfer, return, and re-equip custody
inventorySerialization.state: bounded strict JSON reserved for reviewed charges, hash-bound durability, and other item-specific state
inventorySerialization.stackRows: omit serializedEquipment and use positive safe-integer quantity
inventorySerialization.playerProjection: serialized identity, hashes, configuration, and state are server-private

slotAuthority.representation: complete canonical ordered slot list with explicit nulls
slotAuthority.multiSlotWholeItem: one instance identity may occupy several compatible slots

legacyResolution.representation: unresolved entries separate from effective instances

includes: opaque equipped instance identity and revision
activity status and safe reason codes
omits: serialized inventory identity and item-specific state
legacy unresolved descriptions and candidate sources

invariants: Descriptive inventory rows, trainer equipmentSlots strings, and Pokemon items.held strings are never effective equipment authority.
Every effective instance is canonical-hash-bound, whole-item, source-provenanced, assigned, revisioned, and operation-authored.
A serialized whole item retains one stable instance identity, durable activity, and bounded item-specific state across inventory, equipment, transfers, return, and re-equip.
Active instances have no inactive reasons; every non-active instance has at least one durable reason source.
The embedded equipment owner identity must match the owning sheet before any runtime contribution or operation.
Item-specific configuration is inert unless its configuration and equipment definition hashes are registered and current.
Reviewed durability is initialized only from explicit configuration and reaches broken exactly at zero; unsupported narrative damage requires guided adjudication rather than inferred mutation.

Player sheet and realtime projections never expose source inventory row IDs, source revisions, operation IDs, definition hashes, private configuration values, reason source identities, or serialized durability.
